description: This header file declares functions for retrieving and setting configuration parameters related to 'prplMesh' in a network management context. It includes functions for obtaining hostap interface data, parameter values, radio-specific parameters, integer parameters with default fallback, channel info, WEP keys, and for setting configuration options, including non-volatile commits. It also provides interfaces for managing VAP credentials.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_hostapd_ifaces
methods.description: Retrieves hostap interfaces from the database.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_param
methods.description: Gets the value of a specified parameter from the database.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_radio_param
methods.description: Gets the value of a specific radio parameter.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_param_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value from the database.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_param_int_default
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value, returning a default if missing.

methods.name: cfg_get_channel
methods.description: Gets the channel information for a network interface.

methods.name: cfg_get_wep_key
methods.description: Retrieves WEP key for a given interface and key index.

methods.name: cfg_set_prplmesh_config
methods.description: Sets and commits a configuration option.

methods.name: cfg_set_prplmesh_config_no_commit
methods.description: Sets a configuration option without committing.
